scope: Checkpoint-wide decoder-family planning, per-layer subset residency and a native K4-only payload bound to a K3/K4 package. Not arbitrary-quant end-to-end serving qualification.
implementation: Compute the sorted K2-K5 family once from all target and draft projection metadata; each layer retains the same tier IDs, with zero counts and no packed payload for absent tiers. Uniform checkpoints retain the adjacent dummy tier.
tests: 77 loader tests pass (three environment-dependent tests ignored)
published checkpoint manifest test passes separately: all 43 layers use K3/K4, preserving prior descriptor layouts and sizes
per-layer K3/K4, K2/K5 and K2/K3/K4/K5 subsets retain exact compressed payload sizes and descriptor IDs across TP1/TP2/TP4
native all-K4 payload through a K3/K4 package matches reference bitwise at rows 16/1/3/16 and changed-input graph replay

native_result.scope:
Qualify native two-to-four-tier dispatch, rows and changed-input graphs.

Uniform mode uses zero-membership, minimal-storage adjacent tiers. Homogeneous
experts use separate single-tier B12x grids as the reference. With
--mixed-projections, each expert uses three distinct bitrates and is evaluated
separately by the existing three-tier grid before summing reference outputs.
